Labiraus

Privacy Policy

Effective date: April 7, 2026

This Privacy Policy applies to Labiraus, related authentication endpoints, and associated services operated by the system owner for private administrative use.

Authorized Audience

This service is not offered to the general public. It is intended only for the system owner and any delegates the owner has explicitly authorized to administer, test, or use the system.

Information We Collect

When you use the service, the system may collect and process:

  • basic identity information returned by the authentication provider, including email address
  • authentication status and authorization decisions
  • service usage records, request metadata, and operational logs
  • content you intentionally submit through the interface or connected APIs

How We Use Information

Information is used only to operate and secure the private homelab environment, including:

  • authenticating approved users
  • restricting access to owner-approved delegates
  • auditing, debugging, and maintaining the system
  • protecting the service from misuse, unauthorized access, and operational failures

Access Restrictions

Accounts that are not controlled by the system owner or their designated delegates are not authorized to use this service. Authentication does not guarantee access. The system may deny or revoke access at any time.

Sharing

Information is not shared for advertising or public distribution. Data may be processed by infrastructure and identity providers required to operate the service, including Google or an upstream authentication proxy, solely for authentication, hosting, logging, security, and service administration.

Retention

Information may be retained for as long as reasonably necessary to operate, secure, troubleshoot, and audit the private system. The owner may delete, retain, or archive data at their discretion.

Security

Reasonable efforts may be taken to secure the service, but no system can guarantee absolute security. Because this is a private administrative environment, access should be treated as sensitive and limited to trusted users only.

Your Choices

If you are a designated delegate and want your access reviewed or revoked, contact the system owner directly. Because this is a private system, standard public self-service account workflows may not be available.

Contact

Questions about this policy should be directed to the system owner through the private contact channel already established for this environment.
